scope: Prospective choice of spectral prior for E1-style multi-frame linear GP; no network architecture claim
observation: matched y=A x+epsilon, epsilon iid N(0,sigma^2), no clipping; E1 per-name translations and rotations
calibration_ids: 0001-0032 DIV2K_train_HR, central 512 crop -> avg_pool2d(2); RGB-average zero-padded periodograms, each image normalized before averaging; unit stationary spectrum, DC=0
development_ids: 0801-0812; smoke only 0801-0802; miniature results always separate
target_ids: 0813-0824; not used to develop this choice rule, potentially used in other older research; no claim of globally unseen data
amplitude: All priors use common latent contrast estimate: noise-corrected within-color observation energy / expected centered observation energy of four independent calibration Gaussian probes. CV folds estimate amplitude from training frames only. floor=1e-8
analysis_rule: minimum four-common-probe expected cropped MSE under independent calibration covariance; candidate spectrum/amplitude held fixed during synthetic risk probes; plug-in risk, not target-risk unbiasedness
probe_colors: independent Gaussian channels with same calibrated average spectrum; no cross-color covariance claim
cv: four deterministic folds, frame index modulo 4; eight candidates; 12 train/4 validation frames; validation observation MSE; final selected prior refit on all 16 frames

solver.algorithm: PCG with fixed quarter-power SPD FFT preconditioner
solver.preconditioner: diagonal=[1+Pspec*(n_training_frames/S^2)*(HR/field)^2*sinc(S*fx)^2*sinc(S*fy)^2/nu]^(1/4); inverse FFT division; fixed damping chosen on synthetic CPU development only; exact M unchanged
solver.convergence_certificate: fresh rhs-M(x) norm / rhs norm <1e-5; recursive trigger failing true residual restarts PCG; last iteration also checks true residual
solver.failure: nonconvergence/nonfinite/nonpositive curvature retained as failure; no ranking on partial candidate set

numerical_revision: v1 mini failed600 float32 steps; v2 mini passed but full0801 sigma=.01 failed1200, true residual0.00049766581; v3 full first risk fit failed1200 true residual5.1847895e-5, select32.52seconds. No target/score ran for full cases. v2/v3 source/protocol/check snapshots preserved under versions/. v4 only raises iteration cap4000, keeping posterior/tolerance/preconditioner/statistics. New development/formal roots mandatory.
selection_boundary: select opens observations.npz/calibration.npz only; all 36 target choices and chosen outputs must be committed with SHA256 cohort manifest before score opens evaluation_truth; offline oracle uses same eight fixed candidates, no true-spectrum oracle

resources.on_exhaustion: keep incomplete, no outcome-dependent cohort truncation
resources.budget_revision_reason: Changed before target launch, based only on full development timing:36cases times64 selection fits plus final/oracle unlikely fit8h. Freeze full cohort; no result-based case deletion.

costs: Record timed GPU synchronization, every CG convergence record, A/At calls and interpolated sample count, peak allocated GPU memory; common reference preparation and all failures count in resources ledger; 32 risk fits vs 32 CV fits is not exact compute matching
statistics: image-cluster bootstrap 10000 seed=20261008; average three noise settings within image for primary gain, separately report each noise; report missing/failed cases before complete-cohort statistics
claim_gates: Effective over default only if complete-cohort mean PSNR gain image-bootstrap 95% lower bound>0 and severe-degradation rate<=5%; superiority over CV only if paired gain lower bound>0, severe-rate no worse, and total selection+refit GPU seconds<=CV; otherwise do not claim superiority or cheap selection
limitations: unknown signal nullspace cannot be identified from y; reference calibration controls invisible frequencies
